name: Ayushman Bharat - Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (PM-JAY)
name_hi: आयुष्मान भारत - प्रधानमंत्री जन आरोग्य योजना (पीएम-जेएवाई)
ministry: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
summary: World's largest health insurance scheme providing ₹5 lakh per family per year for secondary and tertiary care hospitalization to economically vulnerable families.
summary_hi: दुनिया की सबसे बड़ी स्वास्थ्य बीमा योजना, जो आर्थिक रूप से कमजोर परिवारों को माध्यमिक और तृतीयक देखभाल अस्पताल में भर्ती होने पर प्रति परिवार प्रति वर्ष ₹5 लाख का कवर प्रदान करती है।
benefits: Health insurance cover of ₹5,00,000 per family per year
Covers pre-hospitalization (3 days) and post-hospitalization (15 days) expenses
Cashless treatment at empaneled public and private hospitals
No cap on family size or age of members
Pre-existing diseases covered from day one
Transportation allowance up to ₹1,000 per hospitalization

who_can_apply: Families living in rural areas with predefined deprivation criteria (D1-D5)
Urban families belonging to 11 defined occupational categories (rag pickers, beggars, domestic workers, etc.)
All families already covered under RSBY or other state health schemes may be migrated
who_cannot_apply: Families not listed in the SECC 2011 deprivation database
Families having a member with a government job
Families owning agricultural land above state-specific thresholds
documents_required: SECC 2011 ration card number or PM-JAY card
Identification proof (Voter ID, Driving License, etc.)

how_to_apply: Check eligibility by sending PMJAY to 56677 or visiting pmjay.gov.in
If eligible, visit any empaneled hospital with identification documents
The hospital's Ayushman Mitra will verify your details through the PM-JAY portal
A PM-JAY e-card will be generated on the spot
Treatment is cashless — no money needs to be paid at empaneled hospitals

faq.q: How do I know if my family is eligible?
faq.a: Type PMJAY and send to 56677 from your mobile, or visit pmjay.gov.in and check eligibility with your ration card or mobile number.

faq.q: Do I need to pay any premium?
faq.a: No. PM-JAY is fully government-funded. There is no premium, no enrollment fee, and no renewal fee.

faq.q: Can I get treatment in any hospital?
faq.a: Only at empaneled public and private hospitals. Check pmjay.gov.in for the list of empaneled hospitals near you.

faq.q: I lost my PM-JAY card — what do I do?
faq.a: Visit any empaneled hospital and they can regenerate your e-card using Aadhaar or other ID. You can also download it from pmjay.gov.in.
